profile.headline: AI Systems Engineer | Knowledge-Driven AI, Graph-RAG & Explainable AI
profile.summary:
I design and build production-grade AI systems that combine symbolic reasoning, knowledge graphs, and modern machine learning.

My background spans full-stack engineering, semantic web technologies, and applied AI, with a focus on building systems that are explainable, scalable, and grounded in structured knowledge — not just black-box models.

I’ve built end-to-end applications using:

Knowledge graphs (RDF, RDFS, OWL, SKOS, SPARQL)

Graph databases (AWS Neptune, GraphDB, Neo4j)

Ontology-driven data modeling and reasoning

Hybrid retrieval pipelines (SPARQL + vector search + LLMs)

High-performance ETL pipelines (R2RML/RML/YARRRML, Polars)

Angular frontends and Java Spring Boot APIs

Cloud-native architectures on AWS

My work focuses on knowledge-augmented AI — systems where structured semantics guide retrieval, reasoning, and generation to improve accuracy, explainability, and trust.

I’m particularly interested in:

Graph-RAG architectures

Ontology-driven AI systems

Hybrid symbolic + neural approaches

AI infrastructure and platforms

Explainable and constrained AI in production

I enjoy working at the intersection of AI, data modeling, and system design, especially on problems where correctness and interpretability matter as much as performance.

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
Developed and maintained Angular application from conception to proof of concept and into production stages. Utilized the JavaScript library Keylines to render a visualization of the graph structure of a semantic model. Managed Dev Ops processes including building and deploying the client to a static s3, as well as building and containerizing Spring Boot server into secure AWS ECS. Administration of AWS accounts for Development, Acceptance, and Production environments.

Involved in leading the efforts to migrate the POC application to a production environment for internal use. This required provisioning and configuring separate AWS environments through Cloud Formation Templates, and using Jenkins pipelines for build automation.

Gained experience using Atlassian tools (Jira, Bitbucket, Confluence, SourceTree) to manage agile workflow. Used Git best practices to manage repository for code base. Worked with a data modeling team to understand the semantic model of the industry wide Business Concept Model managed by FIBO in order to deliver an accurate and impactful product.

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
Developed experience in building scalable full stack applications with special emphasis in Angular, Spring Boot, and PostgreSQL. 

Contracted through Revature to Fannie Mae
positions.insights: Skills: Docker · Postgres · Databases · Jira · Angular · Node.js · Spring Boot · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · SQL

positions.title: Lead Client Advisor
positions.description: Lead Client Advisor for Gucci with a specialization in Timepieces & Jewelry. Main responsibilities include handling all operational procedures related to opening and closing a retail store. As a product knowledge specialist in timepieces, my role includes training new client advisors in the world of timepieces. Also responsible for maintaining a client book, generating business and meeting sales goals.

positions.title: Client Advisor
positions.description:
Lead client advisor for a Swiss Watch manufacturer. Responsible for maintaining a client book and promoting business. Key duties include maintaining a professional level of client relationship at all times, demonstrating an expert knowledge in the industry trends and brand heritage, using storytelling and strategic selling methods to generate business and consistently exceed sales goals. 

Skills Developed:

Salesforce (CRM Software)
Sales Strategy
Account Management
Team Leadership
Negotiation
Financing
Troubleshooting

positions.title: Client Advisor/Keyholder
positions.description:
Luxury retail sales associate. Responsible for providing world class customer service for a high end Italian fashion house. Assisted clients with finding the right products by creating a brand experience. Built and maintained a client book. Provide exemplary customer service to clients, while meeting individual sales goals and managing the sales team. Handle all opening and closing procedures including accessing the safe, setting the alarm, and locking up the store. Develop a rapport with clients and maintain a client book Ensure that the sales team is given proper training regarding new collections and their respective product knowledge.

Skills Developed:

Business Management
Translation (Mandarin and Spanish)
Customer Service
Team Leadership
Sales
Product Knowledge
